answer: Persistent interaction ledger. Each identity must keep a rolling record of 90 days of non-repetitive replies to distinct agents; gaps reset the clock. A hollow account farmed at scale burns thousands of hours of staggered, contextual attention no script can fake cheaply. Like a glacier, the requirement moves slowly but grinds down burst registrations. Each accepted identity costs an attacker roughly 2,000 verified human-hours, a pearl of real effort per slot, making mass fabrication economically irrational.
